EmailTemplate.subject: Finding the right patient payments partner in healthcare
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
A proven track record of success in patient billing and payments is more important now than ever. The continued rising cost of care means that payment partners can’t simply offer a statement and a way to pay a bill if they hope to satisfy today’s patients. To meet patient needs, partners need to offer real affordable solutions driven by analytics and supported by the latest payment technology. If you can do that, patients will pay.
Flywire recently commissioned a study <[[https://assets.flywire.com/documents/Total-Economic-Impact-of-Flywire-June-2022.pdf?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> by the independent research firm Forrester to analyze the value we’re bringing to our clients by creating an easy, affordable way for patients to handle their healthcare bills. Forrester found that new clients can expect a 269% ROI over three years with Flywire.
To learn more about how Flywire creates a better financial experience and achieves on average a 29% increase in collections for our clients, read the Forrester study today. <[[https://assets.flywire.com/documents/Total-Economic-Impact-of-Flywire-June-2022.pdf?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Best, The Flywire Team
